comments.body: Oh! Good to know! Thanks, I'll implement that now. Still though, I feel like that should be exposed in the module? If nothing else that feels like an important option to surface.

I think you are looking at unstable options, which botPolicy was made an alias to the new .policy
botPolicy is unchanged in 25.11

Oh no, I mean making the type exposed as an option independently. Some way to just indicate, without needing to make other changes, that I'd prefer the non-js challenge.

Right now, at least to me, it wasn't clear how to get from "I want to use that challenge" to "I am now using that challenge" - The way to change it is buried inside `.policy`/`.botPolicy` and Anubis's own documentation didn't lead me in the direction of thinking that this was where that went, and the comments as seen on nixos.org don't give any hint in that regard either. Even just giving an example in the comment under the option in the search would probably be enough, but a string input just asking for it would be fantastic.

I hope what I'm saying makes sense.

### Nixpkgs version

- Stable (25.11)

### Describe the bug

There's doesn't seem to be a way to configure https://anubis.techaro.lol/docs/admin/configuration/challenges/metarefresh via the NixOS/Anubis module, unless I'm missing somthing.

### Steps to reproduce

Perhaps a [services.anubis.instances.<name>.](https://search.nixos.org/options?channel=25.11&include_modular_service_options=1&include_nixos_options=1&query=anubis).challengeType or somthing?

### Expected behaviour

I should be able to allow people not using Javascript access to the site.
